sources: USGS 3DEP/NED 1/3 arc-second (10 m) elevation sampled on a 200 m grid via api.opentopodata.org (ned10m), 2026-11-22; slope = central-difference over 400 m
metadata.notes: Geometry clipped to a 3 km circle. Distances are straight-line from the center to the nearest point of the feature. OSM data is crowd-sourced: verify on the ground and against Alameda County Flood Control (acfloodcontrol.org) maps before relying on it.
